annotations.title: Past Storm Leads by Address (county preview)

description: COUNTY LEVEL, FREE, PAST 365 DAYS. Past Storm Leads by Address: Reported and Radar-Detected, Last 365 Days. Use when the question is how much storm activity a county has had in the past year: event counts, storm types, measured severity ranges and repeat properties. Input is state plus county, never a street address. Not for one property (use get_address_report), not for the 2003-to-present record (use get_property_storm_history_report), not for future storms (use get_risk_forecast). Not a damage assessment. For the paid address-level list, call get_weather_data with dataset=storms and addresses=true ($0.05 per address; needs an Atlas United Data API key or an x402 payment).

county.description: County name without the word 'County', e.g. Dallas.

min_severity.description: Minimum severity, e.g. 1.75 for golf-ball hail.

peril.description: Storm/risk type filter. Used by dataset=storms and dataset=risk (narrows to one storm type -- use the exact names returned under storm_types in a free preview) and by dataset=at_risk (narrows to one peril bucket, a different real meaning -- check that dataset's own preview for its real values). Common storms/risk values: HAIL, THUNDERSTORM_WIND, FLASH_FLOOD, HEAVY_RAIN, FLOOD, TORNADO.
